protocol.authoring: Two agents independently wrote six new families each without reading each other or existing family templates/labels.
protocol.review: Two additional agents reviewed all 24 opaque shuffled packets containing title, body, commit messages, patches, supplied review, and rubric only. Neither saw labels, scenario names, author IDs, or each other’s answers.
protocol.adjudication: The coordinating author compared both blind passes with provisional intent, retained both rationales, corrected one clearly erroneous testing label, and left six disputed triviality judgments uncertain.
protocol.limitations: All participants use the same model family. No human review, inference-provider evaluation, patch execution, or calibration is claimed.
